description: The Municipality of Lecce publishes electricity consumption for public buildings and public infrastructure, described as updated to 2007. The municipal catalogue identifies one CSV resource for public-sector electricity users. The dataset provides a historical demand input for planning the electricity supply serving municipal assets. The source does not describe a calibrated energy model or establish the load profile within a day. Its short metadata also leaves measurement units, individual column definitions and the precise start of the observation period unstated. The CSV is reached through the public catalogue and a legacy shortened distribution link. Access is free under Creative Commons Attribution, with no version specified in the inspected licence metadata. A caveat is that a later catalogue metadata change does not update the stated 2007 observations. The separately catalogued Lecce street-lighting consumption record concerns a specific end use and period; it is not asserted to be identical to this building and infrastructure dataset.
